notes.title: CO-OP MULTIPLAYER has arrived in The NAKI Files Demo!
notes.content: [p]After 5 months banging my head against the wall trying to turn this single-player game into a multiplayer online game via Steam, with a LAN option (for those friends who will pirate the game in the future but still want to play), it was… extremely challenging.[/p][h3][b]What’s New in this Demo[/b][/h3][p]New 3D models, everything revamped. Sure, the environment still looks familiar, though I did polish a spot or two, but the Anunnaki models now have different textures so we can tell them apart.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/b453ef47b2cb8e64f29de1d5e8105509c3dc86bb.png"][/img][/p][p]There’s a new cutscene that does two things at once: it talks about the game’s story and also tells you what to do. It’s a two-in-one: tutorial and intro. Wanna see? Open the game, you lazy bum.[/p][p]The main gameplay mechanic got an overhaul. Now instead of 1 topic at a time, you handle 3. And throughout the level, “Censored Pages” are introduced. These are pages you want to AVOID publishing, because the world government will reduce their reach, and you’ll awaken fewer people because of it.[/p][p]There’s also a new upgrade mechanic. Now players receive “Amazon Stones” instead of leveling up. These stones can be placed in altars scattered around the map. The benefits each altar grants change every match.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/2378ecb96b6640089fab3a6bfb8d9c2ceafea9dd.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve got skins! Tons of skins! And they’re mix-and-match too. So if you like one but prefer the hood from another, you can combine them however you want. They’re all free and unlocked from the start.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/d47f1507d7072b19a1f88583b5d86c76f027e336.gif"][/img][/p][p]New mechanics also include: flushing the toilet, flying with the fire extinguisher, drinking extinguisher refill fluid, haunting your friend’s flashlight when dead, and other atrocities. If it was fun, I added it![/p][p]If I were to list everything that changed, this would become a wall of text. Go play it! NOW! That’s an order. Play with your friends, then tell me how it went by emailing me at [url="https://dev.brunoperes@gmail.com"]dev.brunoperes@gmail.com[/url] in your preferred language.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/d6b1a3810dee834553a2d8b50670e280b0de0fc5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Thanks & Discord[/b][/h3][p]A huge thanks to all my friends who helped test and test and test this new version. Tons of bugs happened, I lost count, and more will come! So make sure to join our Discord to report future bugs.[/p][p]-- TheLastMage[/p]

notes.title: New Demo on the Horizon! Here's What to Expect
notes.content: [p]So many things are changing behind the scenes that I can't even list them all.[/p][p]First and most important: MULTIPLAYER! And, if the deadline allows, with Voice Chat (VOIP).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/205a59a5f4c0600b7dff1169744458a200da30cf.png"][/img][/p][p]Anunnaki has a new look, as you can see from the amazing thumbnail on The NAKI Files page.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/598aa6f6b6026d2849d6d3a545ab8c0f32dbd8cc.gif"][/img][/p][p]We also have new outfits, since everyone was complaining about the shade of green. I think it looks great and contrasts well with red – unless you have the most common type of color blindness.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/d47f1507d7072b19a1f88583b5d86c76f027e336.gif"][/img][/p][p]The core mechanic, where you search for and insert topics into the laptop, is being improved. Now there will be 3 simultaneous topics, and the group's goal is to wake up as many people as possible within a maximum of 3 uploads.[/p][p]We’ve also made interface improvements, especially in readability. Amulets will be selectable before the game starts, and their prices will be adjusted for the new mechanic that’s coming.[/p][p]Several bugs have been fixed, and we’ve added many quality-of-life improvements to make the game more intuitive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/0d101cc16545e0694e1c2172b20efaaa3e8134ac.gif"][/img][/p][p]We have a Discord server for feedback and bug reports, although it’s currently a bit quiet.[/p][p]The demo relaunch is scheduled for July 18, and the full game is set to release on October 31, 2025. Add it to your wishlist – we’ve got plenty of new stuff coming.[/p][p]Below is a video I quickly recorded to show a friend how the game's introduction turned out. The video shows the intro in both Portuguese and Japanese. Just like the rest of the game, we also support English, Simplified Chinese, French, and Spanish.[/p][previewyoutube="GuttiC02dbk;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Game startup issue fixed! Welcome to the new update.
notes.content:
In theory, the issue (of the demo not opening) has been resolved! If you still can't open the game, first try Verifying the Integrity of Game Files. If the issue persists, or if you have feedback about the Demo, contact me directly via email at dev.brunoperes@gmail.com  

Sorry for the inconvenience! I spent all of yesterday trying to fix this.  

That said, welcome to the new update!

notes.title: Known Issues (UPDATE)
notes.content:
[strike]I am aware that the game doesn't open after this latest update. This is partly my fault and partly Steamworks'. Now, I'm waiting for a response from Steam Support to publish the update.  [/strike]
[b]Update: The issue was fixed in this latest update. [/b]

There are other bugs in the Demo as well, but they shouldn't affect the main experience. That said, I am aware of them, and they will be fixed as soon as possible:  
- Settings menu doesn't display saved values, although they are active.  
- Fire extinguisher sinks into the floor when swapped with another item.  
- Placing a plate in the Scanner (for some reason) and breaking the plate will render the Scanner unusable. Honestly, this bug is somewhat realistic, as if this happened in real life, it would make total sense for the Scanner to stop working.  
[b]- The first time you run the game, there will be some stutters the first time certain things happen. This is normal; it's called "Shader Compilation," and once compiled, the stutters won't happen again.  [/b]

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: NEW demo update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352632/a2c9f48a34f4f45cf2d5078eec29b11a589f50b1.gif[/img]

- Polished textures and overall appearance of the game, now following the color palette more closely.  
- The Scanner has been updated with a more intuitive and readable display.  
- The game's resolution has been increased to improve readability. If you previously had no issues reading in the game and want to maintain the same performance as before, I recommend reducing the Resolution Scale in the video settings.  
- Added a Run button.  
- You now have only 2 minutes to prepare the house.  
- And more things I can't even remember. It’s been a hectic month.  

I sincerely thank the first 100 people who added the game to their Wishlist, and especially those who played the demo as soon as it was released and sent me personal feedback. I listened to the feedback and did my best this past month to make the demo experience even better.  

If you tried the game, found it confusing, and quit, I kindly ask you to give it a second chance. A subtle tutorial has been added at the beginning of the game.
